description: Check a Coinbase (USDC) payment created by get_domain_purchase_coinbase_pay_link, get_domain_register_coinbase_pay_link or get_add_funds_coinbase_pay_link, and complete the purchase / registration / funds credit once it is paid. Call this after the checkout link has been paid. status is one of: 'pending' (not confirmed yet — wait a little and call again), 'completed' (domain purchased / funds credited — tell the user), 'failed' (checkout expired or failed, nothing captured — offer a new link), 'refunded' (paid, but the registry rejected the registration — the amount was credited to the Atom account balance), or 'needs_support' (paid but could not be applied automatically — give the user the message as-is).

payment_code.description: payment_code returned by the Coinbase pay-link tool.

name: get_coinbase_payment_status
